name: Vivid Army
storyline: Train a colorful roster of troops across land, sea, and air, defeat hostile forces, and push your campaign out into the wider world. Once you step onto the global battlefield, the focus shifts to building even greater strength—upgrading your forces while cooperating and competing with other players to secure more resources and claim the advantage.
summary: Vivid Army is a browser-based real-time strategy game where you grow and command your own military base. Build an army across three branches—land, sea, and air—recruit powerful heroes, and develop your facilities through a variety of interconnected systems. Take on daily missions to steadily strengthen your forces, then join a guild and dive into large-scale competitions that pit you against players across the server—and beyond.
